'''TJ-912''' was a [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] that was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They served under [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku's]] [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] and [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]], [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]], and commanded the forces of the Separatists during the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle of Sullust]] against [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. As the battle went on, they were tasked by the Count with eliminating Ventress, as ordered to Dooku by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]. The tactical droid did all they could to see that this was accomplished before it seemed that they had succeeded and was ordered to retreat from the battle.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Yes, my lord. Ventress is battling the Jedi onboard the command ship.''"<br />"''Turn your guns on our command ship and open fire!''"<br />"''But, my lord, I calculate that will destroy Ventress, the Jedi and all our forces.''"<br />"''Precisely.|TJ-912 conferring with Count Dooku|<ref name="Nightsisters" />}}
[[File:TJ912Dooku-Nightsisters.png|thumb|left|220px|TJ-912 conferring with Count Dooku via hologram.]]
TJ-912 served Asajj Ventress, the greatest of Count Dooku's [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolytes]], in a Sullust system battle. The Separatists were fighting a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] fleet led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Obi-Wan Kenobi and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Anakin Skywalker, who were flying [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|their]] [[Anakin Skywalker's Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Jedi]] [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|starfighters]]. The tactical droid commanded Separatist forces from a [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|destroyer]] while Ventress herself led the assault from the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|command ship]], soon personally joining in the attack in her [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|Ginivex-class starfighter]]. The assassin soon participated in a dogfight with Kenobi and Skywalker before she and Kenobi crashed into the main hangar of the command ship, soon followed in by Skywalker.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

As the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] engaged in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] with her Jedi nemeses, Count Dooku made contact with TJ-912 via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] on the bridge of their frigate. The Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] had been ordered by his own master, Darth Sidious, to eliminate his apprentice in order to prove where his loyalty truly lay. The tactical droid informed Dooku that Ventress was dueling the Jedi on their command ship. He then ordered them to fire upon the ship. TJ-912 questioned the order, but ultimately followed it when Dooku confirmed his intention to destroy both the Jedi and Ventress. The Count was also displeased that the Separatists were in fact losing the battle and began ordering their reinforcements to retreat. Once their destroyer was in position, the tactical droid directed their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] underlings to open fire on the ship containing Ventress. To ensure the job was done, TJ-912 then contacted a nearby [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|bomber]] and ordered it to calculate its flight path to terminate in the ship's main hangar.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

[[File:TJ912OpenFire-Nightsisters.png|thumb|right|220px|TJ-912 commanding forces from their destroyer's bridge.]]
TJ-912 anticipated that the bomber crashing and exploding within the command ship's hangar would either finish the two Jedi and Ventress or leave them unable to escape the flagship's destruction. Despite this attempt, the bomber barely missed the three combatants, and they were therefore able to get back to their fighters as two adjacent Republic cruisers continued to blast away at the ship from both sides. It soon exploded from the unyielding cannon-fire, prompting TJ-912 to contact their superior once more. She informed the Confederate leader of the command ship's destruction and that their scanning indicated there were no survivors, unaware that Ventress had in fact escaped at the last moment. Pleased his aim had presumably been accomplished, Count Dooku declared the tactical droid's work done and ordered them to recall the remaining ships of the fleet from the area, an order they acknowledged.<ref name="Nightsisters" />

==Behind the scenes==
TJ-912 was voiced by [[Cara Pifko]].

The line they quote in the episode in response to an order ("By your command") is a classic ''Battlestar Galactica'' line often uttered by Cylons.<ref name="NEG">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode312.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Nightsisters}}</ref>
